whatsappMessage:
Hi SS Dental Health Friendly Clinic team,

I noticed your clinic has an exceptional 5.0★ rating with 95+ reviews in Kadamkuan, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking page for new patient appointments.

Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp consultation booking, dental treatments list, aur location map integrate kiya hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/ssdental

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi SS Dental Health Friendly Clinic team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with mobile-first appointment booking and a showcase of your 5-star dental practice in Kadamkuan. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?"
